text:
maria-partnerships: Quick recap from the vendor onboarding: their license forbids public distribution of model binaries in certain EU/APAC countries. They still permit hosted inference and customer-managed private deploys, but no open downloads. How do we reflect this in marketplace SKUs and SI workflows?

jordan-legal: We need an annex. Key points: enumerate restricted territories, prohibit public binary publishing, allow hosting and managed/private deploys, and permit limited SI downloads only under NDA + logged, time-limited access. I'll draft wording.

sam-eng: Runtime note: hosted + dedicated unaffected. For private deploys we can avoid a public download by either pushing an encrypted image into customer infra or producing an ephemeral signed artifact for a whitelisted SI. Both routes are doable with existing artifact-service.

kevin-product: Marketplace change: add metadata field `download_allowed` with enum {"public","restricted","none"}. When `restricted`, hide the download button and show "Request managed deploy" and "Request SI validation" actions.

alice-ops: Ops concerns: encrypted image + remote deploy or ephemeral artifact requires KMS integration, per-customer keying, signed S3 URLs, and a post-deploy attestation that we store for audits. Estimate +2 sprints for automation plus a security review.

maria-partnerships: Jordan, draft annex with SI exception language (one-time, auditable download to whitelisted SI under NDA, 48h expiry). Rahul, which SIs can handle a 48h validation window?

rahul-siemanager: I have a shortlist of 3 SIs that can sign NDAs quickly and validate within 48h. We'll need a portal to attach lab reports back to the ticket.

jordan-legal: Will share a first-pass annex by tomorrow AM. Recommend log retention 2 years and response SLA for audit requests.

sam-eng: Implementation plan: spike adding `model.metadata.download_allowed` and wire artifact endpoint `/artifacts/generate?signed=true&ttl=48h&ticket=ID`. Artifact carries hash + signature. Use artifact-service for initial rollout.

kevin-product: I'll mock the UX and acceptance criteria today: show request form (company, SI partner, justification, target validation dates). Approved requests create a ticket for Ops/Partnerships.

alice-ops: Ops runbook outline: KMS per-partner, per-download logs (IP, timestamp), revoke capability, store SI-signed manifest post-validate. Manual fallback: Redwood performs deploy if SI can't.

maria-partnerships: Timeline: present annex + UX plan to vendor on Friday. Owners: Jordan (legal annex), Kevin (marketplace mock), Sam (artifact spike), Alice (ops runbook), Rahul (SI shortlist).

announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Vendor annex prep" Fri 09:00 PT  invites sent.

maria-partnerships: Great. If vendor pushes back, we propose narrow change: allow ephemeral SI-only downloads + strict audit instead of changing global redistribution rule. Will update after legal review. :thumbsup:
